description: This file defines a React component 'Toolbar' that provides UI controls for a Kanban board application, including functions for downloading templates, exporting data, bulk uploading via Excel, CSV sync and undo functionality, and UI toggles for fullscreen and compact modes.

methods.name: downloadExcelTemplate()
methods.description: Generates and triggers download of an Excel template file with predefined columns for Kanban cards.

methods.name: handleAddColumn
methods.description: Handles opening the modal to add a new column to the Kanban board.

methods.name: handleAddColumnSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the new column form, adds the column, and provides user feedback.

methods.name: handleExcelUpload
methods.description: Reads uploaded Excel file, parses data, and shows modal for column selection for bulk upload.

methods.name: handleConfirmBulkUpload
methods.description: Confirms bulk upload, processes rows into cards, and calls bulk insert function.

methods.name: handleExportCardsCsv
methods.description: Exports the current set of cards to a CSV file and triggers download.

methods.name: handleCsvFileSelected
methods.description: Reads and previews the CSV file selected for sync, checking for required columns.

methods.name: handleConfirmCsvSync
methods.description: Performs CSV data sync, including error handling and state updates.

methods.name: handleUndoCsvSync
methods.description: Reverts the last CSV sync using undo flow, with user feedback and state management.

methods.name: Toolbar({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true })

ctags.name: Toolbar
ctags.pattern: /^function Toolbar({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true })
